entities.name: Harald von Hirschfeld

entities.summary: Harald von Hirschfeld was a general in the Wehrmacht of Nazi Germany who commanded the 78. Volksgrenadier-Division during World War II. He was a recipient of the Knight's Cross of the Iron Cross with Oak Leaves.
